gloss: outside the group; outside one's department; nonmember

definitions.gloss: outside the group; outside one's department or organization
definitions.explanation: A formal noun used in administrative and corporate contexts to refer to people, things, or matters that are outside a particular department, division, or organization. The most common collocation is {部外者|ぶがいしゃ} ("outsider, nonmember"). Combines {部|ぶ} ("section, department, group") with {外|がい} ("outside").

examples.japanese: {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入り：10671_tachiiri⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧。
{部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}せないで→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This material is confidential to our department, so please don't show it to anyone else.

examples.japanese: {部外|ぶがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{広報|こうほう}→広報：05228_kouhou⟧⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Inquiries from outside the department are handled by the public relations division.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部内|ぶない}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{部外|ぶがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦いただいて→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: This meeting is internal-only, and we are asking those outside the department to refrain from attending.

notes:
{部外|ぶがい} is a formal compound used in workplaces, government offices, and other organizations to designate people or information as belonging outside a specific department or in-group. It rarely stands alone; it almost always appears as part of a longer compound — most prominently ⟦{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}→部外者：15595_bugaisha⟧ ("outsider") and {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ} ("confidential, restricted to department members").

FORMS:
- ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ("department, division, group") + ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ ("outside") → {部外|ぶがい}
- The pair word is {部内|ぶない} ("inside the department")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}→部外者：15595_bugaisha⟧: outsider, nonmember
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ}: confidential to a department, internal-use only
- {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}⟦{立|た}ち{入|い}り→立ち入り：10671_tachiiri⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: "no unauthorized entry" (standard signage)
- {部外|ぶがい}{者|しゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧: to leak information to an outsider
- {部外|ぶがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧: inquiries from outside the organization

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- {部内|ぶない}: inside the department, internal
- ⟦{社外|しゃがい}→社外：17992_shagai⟧: outside the company
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧: inside the company (internal)
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧: external, outside (more general; can refer to any external entity)
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧: internal, inside (the general counterpart of ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧)
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}{者|しゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧: "non-related parties" (more colloquial signage equivalent)

USAGE:
- {部外|ぶがい} is fairly formal and appears most often in administrative or corporate writing, including signs, memos, and policy documents. In casual speech, ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦{関係|かんけい}{者|しゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧ are more natural.
- {部外|ぶがい}{秘|ひ} is one step less restrictive than ⟦{社外|しゃがい}{秘|ひ}→社外秘：24152_shagaihi⟧ ("company confidential") and ⟦{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}→社内秘：26428_shanaihi⟧ ("internal company confidential"); the choice signals exactly which group can see the document.
